validator.files.publisher.label: Publisher
validator.files.checksumSource: Each SHA-256 comes from 6529's signed list of releases. This page checks that signature before it lists a file. The publisher is the name your system should show when it opens the file or, for an archive, the program inside it; this page doesn't check it, so check it yourself.
validator.files.download.label: Download {file}
validator.files.build.withCommit: Build {version}, published {date}, commit {commit}. Earlier builds are under {releases}.
validator.files.build.withoutCommit: Build {version}, published {date}. Earlier builds are under {releases}.
validator.files.check.heading: Check a file
validator.files.check.body: In the folder with the file, run the command for your system and compare what it prints with the SHA-256 above. Windows prints capital letters; the letters and digits must match. If they differ, delete the file.
validator.files.checksums.body: It lists the SHA-256 of every file. On Linux, in a folder with it and your downloads, run {command} to check them all. 6529 also signs the list of releases, and your validator checks that signature before it tells you about a new one.
